description: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has authorized ponatinib as a monotherapy for the treatment of pediatric patients 6 years of age or older with chronic phase chronic myeloid leukaemia (CP-CML) who are resistant to dasatinib or nilotinib; who are intolerant to dasatinib or nilotinib and for whom subsequent treatment with imatinib is not clinically appropriate; or who have the T315I mutation.
